entities.name: Eliza
entities.description: A young, living human necromancer baron on Grixis who commands undead armies and wields a sword of fire.

entities.name: Sedris
entities.description: An ancient lich king of Grixis with a vast undead army, said to trace his ancestry to Vithia.

entities.name: Unx
entities.description: A crumbling necropolis city on Grixis, walled with the ribs of a huge dead beast, ruled by an archdemon and fought over by Eliza and Sedris.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara, a dead world ruled by lich lords and demon princes.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: A demon whose army Eliza expects the archdemon's forces to run into.

entities.name: The Archdemon of Unx
entities.description: The enormous, black-hearted demon who currently rules Unx and took Eliza's bait.

entities.name: Kathari Scout
entities.description: A vulture-like aven scout who serves Eliza, carries messages and says 'haaak'.

entities.name: Skeletal Fire-Dragon
entities.description: A flaming dragon conjured by Eliza's necromancy from the mile-long skeleton in the necropolis wall.

entities.name: Eliza's Fire-Sword
entities.description: A sword that bursts into true flame when drawn and which Eliza uses to ignite the skeleton in the necropolis wall.

entities.name: Necklace of Protection
entities.description: A powerful ward Eliza wore, one of a pair, whose twin she gives away to Sedris.

entities.name: Vithia
entities.description: A place from which some say Sedris traces his ancestry.

entities.name: Sedraxis
entities.description: Sedris's lair, which Eliza says she may see him in.

entities.name: Ilsun Gate
entities.description: Eliza's keep that the scout asks about.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose tri-color angels are discussed in the letter response.

events.summary: Eliza waits outside the necropolis of Unx as one of few living humans left on Grixis, determined to stay alive.
events.quote: She was one of few vital humans left on Grixis, and she was determined to remain that way.

events.summary: Eliza's kathari scout reports that the archdemon took the bait she gave it about a human hermitage and has left Unx.
The scout reports a rival army has massed on the opposite side of Unx; Eliza guesses its leader is the lich king Sedris.
events.quote: Only one mind could be behind the other army, she figured

events.summary: Eliza sends her protection necklace to Sedris as a token to request a meeting, a ploy to get him face to face.
events.quote: Take this to him. Tell him I want to meet.

events.summary: Eliza tells her fleshdoll to ready her armies for war.
events.quote: "Get the others ready," Eliza told it. "Form up for war."

events.summary: Sedris's army arrives and the giant Traitor King steps from his coach to face Eliza.
events.quote: The giant-sized figure of the Traitor King appeared from the coach and walked down the fleshy tendril to her.

events.summary: Sedris demands Eliza's minions serve him and ends her leadership; Eliza refuses.
events.quote: I'm telling you that your leadership is over.

events.summary: Eliza draws her fire-sword, which bursts into flame, and Sedris taunts her to do her worst.
events.quote: With that, Eliza drew her sword.

events.summary: Eliza flings the sword into the necropolis wall instead of attacking Sedris.
events.quote: Instead she drew her arm back and, with all her might, flung the sword into the distance toward the necropolis.

events.summary: Eliza casts her most powerful necromancy spell; flame bursts the wall, revealing a mile-long skeleton that becomes a skeletal fire-dragon.
events.quote: A heartbeat later, the stone of the necropolis wall burst, falling away like ash.

events.summary: Eliza threatens to burn Unx and Sedris's armies unless Sedris leaves.
events.quote: Leave Unx now, and I won't burn it, or your armies, to a cinder.

events.summary: Sedris, told by a ghost minion there is no endgame for him, withdraws his troops from Unx.
events.quote: I'm told that there's no endgame for me here, not with your little fiery friend.

events.summary: Eliza drops the spell and collapses, then sends the scout to follow Sedris with the twin necklace to find his lair, declaring herself baron of Unx.
events.quote: I'm the baron of Unx now.

relations.note: The scout calls her Baron and carries out her errands.
They contend for Unx and she defies his order.
relations.quote: You can't order me, Sedris. You have no thrall over the living.

relations.note: She declares herself baron of Unx.
relations.quote: I'm the baron of Unx now.

relations.note: The necropolis at Unx lies on Grixis.
relations.quote: a species almost forgotten on Grixis
